# Ashik Sharon M

> AI/ML Engineer Intern working on LLM evaluation infrastructure and agentic systems.

## Who this is

Ashik Sharon M is an AI/ML Engineer Intern at CobuildX.ai (Jun 2026-present). He builds agentic
workflows with LangGraph and MCP, and is a major contributor to ai01, an LLM evaluation and
observability platform (async evaluation pipeline on AWS Lambda + SQS, multi-agent trajectory
evaluation, entity-extraction benchmarking, BYOK via litellm, and the ai01-eval Python SDK on PyPI:
https://pypi.org/project/ai01-eval/).

Previously, he was a Graduate Technical Intern in AI Engineering at Intel Technology India
(Jul 2025-Feb 2026), where he built a multi-agent LLM ticket-automation system (35-45% lower
model cost) and an enterprise GraphRAG platform (LlamaIndex, Neo4j, FAISS).

He is finishing an M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (AI & Machine Learning) at
Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), and holds a B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
from Loyola-ICAM College of Engineering & Technology (Anna University).

## Invention disclosures & research

Three invention disclosures (IDF-B) at the VIT IPR & TT Cell; none filed or granted yet:
- "Adaptive Multi-Agent Generative AI System for Automated Legal Contract Drafting and Advisory"
- "Hardware-Accelerated Semantic Downlink of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Data with Onboard Vision-Language Models"
- "Dual-Processor Hallucination-Hardened Generative AI Mission Briefing Engine"

Paper under review, Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation (Elsevier):
"Zero-Shot Land Cover Classification of SAR-like Imagery using Vision-Language Models (VLMs)."
